scientific_integrity: Exact finite cubical chain enumeration and integral Hermite/Smith computations reproducible from embedded code and index certificate. General results in cited literature are credited; independent replication not performed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the two-particle unordered configuration of K_{3,3,3}; classes are disjoint-cycle product tori. The rank-deficient (4,4) quotient is Z of rank 21. Priority beyond inspected primary literature is not independently established.
title: Integral length-restricted product-torus lattices for two particles on the complete tripartite graph
